text:
maya: Heads-up — customer AcmeCorp reports intermittent failures calling the payments tool via the API. They see 400 schema errors complaining about additionalProperties when they include `promo_code`. Works most of the time, fails ~30% of requests. Repro steps below.

maya: Repro CURL they shared:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" -d '{\"tool\":\"payments.charge\",\"args\":{\"customer_id\":\"C-123\",\"amount\":100,\"currency\":\"usd\",\"promo_code\":\"SPRING20\"}}'
```

maya: Response body when it fails (400):
```json
{
  "error": "invalid_request",
  "message": "Tool invocation failed schema validation",
  "details": [
    {"path": "/args", "message": "additional properties are not allowed", "extra": ["promo_code"] }
  ]
}
```

sophie: Can you paste the exact request payload and SDK version? also customer says sometimes the request that fails is identical to one that succeeded.

maya: SDK is customer-embedded v2.3.1. I asked for full logs; they piped request body and it's identical when they re-run after a fail it sometimes passes.

jon: pinging eng-oncall @eng-oncall-bot — this smells like inconsistent schema resolution at runtime (maybe function registry cached older schema?) Could be a race when we deploy function schema update.

eng-oncall-bot: @jon acknowledged — checking function registry and recent schema updates for payments.* in last 24h.

jon: quick check of registry: payments.charge schema currently has "additionalProperties": false. We added a new optional field `promo_code` in the spec two hours ago but the registry publish job may not have propagated to all nodes. If a node has old schema -> rejects unknown fields.

sophie: That explains intermittent behaviour. Is there a roll-forward or hotfix we can do?

jon: mitigation options: 1) update registry to allow "additionalProperties": true for args (fast) 2) patch SDK to strip unknown fields client-side (customer can do) 3) fix propagation so new schema version pushed to all servers reliably (longer). Propose immediate step 1 as hotfix, then rollback if needed.

maya: Customer prefers not to change payloads. They've asked for a timeline.

jon: I'll push a permissive schema update to the registry and kick the propagation job. tagging infra if propagation job needs manual restart.

eng-oncall-bot: Registry update queued; propagation started. Notifying nodes: 12/12 acknowledged.

support-bot: Maya, please ask AcmeCorp to retry after 60s and share a failing request id if they still see failures.

maya: Sent to customer. They retried, success. Will close once they confirm stability. :thumbsup:

sophie: Follow-up: we should add a health check/metric for schema version drift and a CI gate to ensure publish jobs complete before marking schema as live. Filed a ticket: ENG-1247.

jon: added note to changelog and will schedule post-mortem if we see recurrence.

maya: Thanks all, updating the ticket and customer.
